newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EU Commission sees faster Portuguese growth.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission sees faster Portuguese growth.

text.p: The European Commission expects the Portuguese economy to grow at above three percent in 1997 and 1998, with unemployment falling below seven percent at the end of next year, local newspapers reported on Thursday.

Citing a six-monthly survey of European Union states, due to be released soon, the Publico and Diario Economico newspapers said that growth was forecast at 3.2 percent in 1997 and 3.5 percent next year, up from the 2.8 and 3.2 percent, respectively, the Commission had predicted last October.

According to Publico, the public sector deficit would be three percent in 1997, up from the 2.9 percent seen six months ago, but still in line with the target for entry to the single currency. --Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
